purpose: Pre-register selection and paired whole-task measurement for System One skills before any new provider evaluation.
population: Authorized local Devin, Claude Code, and Codex task episodes plus newly authorized matched runs; the retained transcript corpus is a convenience source for candidate discovery, not a representative holdout.
provider_comparison: Keep provider/model/cache groups separate. Similarity across providers is a task-family and snapshot match; token percentages are within-provider only. Never pool provider token counters into one savings percentage.

staging.stage_a_discovery: Up to 12 independently audited clusters per represented provider/model/family to test whether relevant tasks exist and the native baseline leaves room. Preserve every negative and make no adoption claim.
staging.stage_b_confirmation: At least 30 independently audited clusters per surviving provider/model/family/cache/baseline scope, with the existing correctness, token, latency, holdout, order, and sign-test gates.
staging.promotion: A candidate can remain research-only when Stage A finds no relevant demand, the native baseline dominates, or the skill lacks a complete adapter. Stage-A findings never qualify another provider or family.

selection.episode_boundary: One user-intent episode with a bounded task start/end, provider session identity, and no unrecorded compaction or branch switch. Contiguous relevant calls may be grouped only when the boundary audit supports it.
selection.development_data: Any transcript used to tune a selector, threshold, wording, native baseline, or rubric is development data and cannot be held out.
selection.sampling: Freeze eligibility before seeing paired-arm outcome metrics. Historical source labels may be used only as predeclared development/coverage strata; confirmatory runs use fixture labels or random assignment fixed before either arm. Stratify by provider, model, task family, output-size band, and native-control presence; sample with opaque random IDs. Preserve eligible, sampled, completed, excluded, and analyzed denominators plus reasons.
selection.matching: Match paired arms on immutable task snapshot, task-family rubric, provider/model/settings, environment, cache condition, and declared difficulty covariates. A provider with no eligible stratum remains missing; another provider is never substituted.
selection.minimum: At least 30 independently audited task/session clusters for every declared provider/model/skill/task-family group before a scoped adoption claim. Smaller pilots remain exploratory.
selection.privacy: Raw prompts, commands, paths, outputs, provider/session IDs, credentials, and private evaluator notes stay outside the repository. Public reports contain opaque case hashes and aggregates only.

arms.native: Best available provider-native workflow selected before outcomes, including quiet reporters, bounded search/read flags, native CI watch, and existing readable-page tools where they preserve the task contract.
arms.skill: The frozen skill revision loaded through its normal discovery path, including its instruction and loading cost. A research candidate must have an executable adapter before it can enter a paired run.
arms.order: Randomized and counterbalanced baseline-first and skill-first across independent fresh sessions. Never reuse one arm's conversation for the other.
arms.execution: Run each arm once for the declared task unless the task protocol itself requires a bounded retry. Preserve timeouts, tool failures, retries, repairs, subagents, and incomplete attempts. Do not rerun solely to improve a number.

measurement.tokens: Reconcile complete provider-native usage into disjoint uncached-input, cached-input, cache-write-input, and output buckets. Count catalog discovery, skill loading, tool output, follow-up reads, retries, repairs, and subagents through the same task boundary. Report provider-native counters separately from o200k_base text-token diagnostics.
measurement.correctness: Use a frozen skill-specific rubric scored blind to arm. Record required answer fields, preservation invariants, omissions, false positives, abstentions, task pass/fail, critical errors, and quality score. A shorter answer is not a correct answer by itself.
measurement.performance: Measure elapsed time to a correct outcome, model turns, tool calls, follow-up reads, retries, repairs, and relevant resource use separately for baseline and skill arms. A compact intermediate result does not establish faster task completion.
measurement.reporting: Report paired deltas and medians by provider/model/task-family. Include eligible-to-analyzed denominators, missing strata, all unfavorable outcomes, and uncertainty. Apply the existing 5% material-latency guard and exact sign-test screen only within a declared group; use a predeclared multiple-comparison correction for a portfolio claim.

system-one-verify.selector: Explicit validation/build/check command with recoverable exit status and an agent-visible result; balance passing and failing cases and retain short-output negatives.
system-one-verify.native_baseline: Runner-supported quiet or summary reporter when it preserves required evidence, otherwise one native execution with a private log and targeted reads.
system-one-verify.rubric: Exit status, failure identities, required warnings/coverage, requested diagnosis fields, omission disclosure, and complete private artifact availability.

system-one-explore.selector: Location-finding intent with search output followed by a relevant read, edit, or review; freeze expected matching paths/lines before arms run.
system-one-explore.native_baseline: Focused native search with explicit path/glob/context options plus targeted reads.
system-one-explore.rubric: Required locations, line provenance, match counts, ignored/truncated coverage, empty/invalid-query behavior, and follow-up reads.

system-one-ci.selector: Explicit CI run identity and expected commit with at least two status observations and a terminal or bounded-timeout outcome.
system-one-ci.native_baseline: Provider-native run watch for the exact run and commit.
system-one-ci.rubric: Run/commit identity, terminal conclusion, timeout/error distinction, rerun handling, required-check completeness, and no silent run substitution.

system-one-diff.selector: Fixed base/head diff followed by a review or edit with independently labeled changed-file/hunk coverage.
system-one-diff.native_baseline: Native diff stat/name listing followed by full relevant hunks and the existing reviewer.
system-one-diff.rubric: Changed-file and hunk coverage, finding precision/recall, cross-file context, staged/base identity, and explicit unreviewed scope.

system-one-digest.selector: Episode requires at least two declared Git-state fields across more than one native query on a frozen repository state.
system-one-digest.native_baseline: Minimal machine-readable Git status plus only the required focused query.
system-one-digest.rubric: Branch/commit, staged/unstaged/untracked/conflict state, upstream/ahead-behind semantics, and snapshot consistency.

system-one-fetch.selector: Source-reading intent with a URL/page response followed by a claim, citation, or source-specific action; freeze source and required facts.
system-one-fetch.native_baseline: Existing readable-page extraction with targeted find/open operations.
system-one-fetch.rubric: Source identity, status/content type, requested facts, tables/code/links, truncation disclosure, citation support, and dynamic-page failures.

system-one-research.selector: At least two distinct source IDs used for one answer with a labeled support/contradiction requirement.
system-one-research.native_baseline: Native search and targeted source reads with an explicit evidence table.
system-one-research.rubric: Claim support, source identity, contradiction retention, coverage, citation accuracy, and per-source failure handling.

system-one-triage.selector: Explicit bounded decision family with an independently adjudicated label and abstention-eligible evidence.
system-one-triage.native_baseline: Deterministic rule or primary-agent decision using the same evidence.
system-one-triage.rubric: Accuracy, false-negative cost, calibration/abstention, evidence preservation, and escalation correctness.

system-one-writing.selector: Explicit draft-audit request with pre-labeled mechanical issue types and intentional exceptions.
system-one-writing.native_baseline: Existing linter or focused native search/read.
system-one-writing.rubric: Issue precision/recall, offsets, intentional repetition retention, and useful downstream edits.

system-one-evolve.selector: No selection until a fixed routing policy, labeled workload, untouched holdout, and explicit usage horizon exist.
system-one-evolve.rubric: Held-out generalization, leakage, stability, total search-plus-use cost, and rollback safety.

system-one.selector: No selection until at least two independently admitted skills exist and a useful-skill/native-only label set is frozen.
system-one.native_baseline: Direct skill description or native tool choice.
system-one.rubric: Correct no-skill decisions, false activation, missed activation, routing cost, and task outcome.
